messages:
sara: Heads up 92: revisit API Keys UX for next sprint. Focus: safer reveal, fewer fatal CTAs, clarify permission scopes on create. I dropped an updated figma: https://redwood.design/keys-v2 :mag_right:

liam: Quick take 2:16 2: the create flow feels too heavy. Suggestion: split into two micro-steps2: create metadata (name, scopes, expiry) then a separate reveal screen. That keeps accidental copying down.

nora: Accessibility notes: when secret is revealed, announce with `role="status"` and `aria-live="polite"`. The reveal button needs `aria-expanded` and show a visible focus ring. Also include a hidden hint: "this secret will be shown once".

diego: For rotate: instead of swapping key immediately, show "Create rotated key" stage with a required sanity checklist checkbox for deploys updated. Add a toggled grace window (default 24h) and a cancel-revoke CTA during grace. We should surface number of linked services (estimated) to signal risk.

zoe: Copy suggestion for create success modal (short):
````
Success: New API key created
This key will be shown once. Copy it now and store it securely.
[Copy key] [Done]
```
Also suggest dimming the copy button for ephemeral keys and showing a tiny help icon linking to rotation docs.

liam: UX micro-nit: primary action label should be simple: 'Copy key' not 'Create and copy' because that implies both creating and copying are atomic. Also add a small toast on copy: 'Key copied. This is the only time you will see it.'

ops-bot: infra-check: added telemetry flag to log reveal events for audit (flag: key_reveal_logging=true).

sara: Empty state idea for Keys page: big CTA 'Create API key' + a short card explaining scopes and recommended rotation cadence (30-90 days). Accessibility version: provide a keyboard-first shortcut 'c' to open create modal.

nora: A11y copy tweak: prefer "This key will no longer grant access after revocation" vs "stop access". Use plain language and short sentences for screenreaders. Also require at least 3 ways to cancel a revoke in the flow (esc, cancel button, click outside).

diego: Bulk actions: when selecting >1 key and choosing rotate, show a summarized risk card: number of affected services, estimated downtime if auto-revoke, and a slider to set grace window. Default should err on caution (grace enabled).

sara: Agree. Follow-ups: liam can mock the two-step create, nora add aria attributes and keyboard flows to acceptance tests, diego wire up grace UI states. I'll write copy for the success and revoke prompts and push to staging. Thanks!
